sources.title: قانون اتحادي رقم (29) لسنة 2006 في شأن حقوق المعاقين
sources.issuer: United Arab Emirates — Federal Government (UAE Legislation)
sources.document_version: Official Gazette No. 453; last updated 16 December 2009

excerpt.text: تكفل الدولة للمعاق ممارسة حقه في التعبير وإبداء الرأي باستخدام طريقة (برايل) ولغة الإشارة وغيرها من طرق التواصل، وحقه في طلب المعلومات وتلقيها ونقلها على قدم المساواة مع الآخرين.

provisions.heading: Definitions and discrimination
provisions.summary: The Law defines disability, the disability card and discrimination, including distinctions that prejudice rights or equal enjoyment of rights.

provisions.heading: Equality and non-discrimination
provisions.summary: The Law aims to secure rights and services and requires equality and non-discrimination across legislation, policies and development programmes.

provisions.heading: Communication and information rights
provisions.summary: The State is to secure expression and opinion through Braille, sign language and other communication means, and the right to request, receive and transmit information on an equal footing.

provisions.heading: Accessible cultural materials
provisions.summary: The State is to provide literary and cultural materials in available forms, including electronic texts, sign language, Braille, audio and multimedia.

provisions.heading: Adapted environment and facilities
provisions.summary: The Law recognises a right to an adapted environment and requires engineering standards for public facilities, applying to the government and private sectors unless exempted.

interpretations.statement: Whether Articles 7 and 20 apply to government websites, apps and digital services, or only to the formats and services expressly listed, requires legal review.
interpretations.observation: Article 7 covers expression, Braille, sign language, other communication means and information; Article 20(2) lists electronic texts, sign language, Braille, audio and multimedia.

interpretations.statement: The implementing Cabinet decision and technical standards contemplated by Article 23 are not captured; their content and current status are unresolved.
interpretations.observation: Article 23 requires the competent authorities to set engineering standards and a Cabinet decision to issue controls and exemptions.

interpretations.statement: The relationship between this 2006 Law, Cabinet Resolution 43/2018 and the 2024 National Digital Accessibility Policy needs a consolidated reading.
interpretations.observation: The Law, the 2018 Cabinet Resolution and the 2024 policy address different aspects of disability inclusion and digital accessibility.

interpretations.statement: The official English translation and the Arabic text may differ; Arabic prevails and native legal review is outstanding.
interpretations.observation: The UAE Legislation platform provides an English translation and states that the Arabic text prevails in case of conflict.
